tunnel.title: ChatGPT connection
tunnel.description: Use OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel to query your local knowledge in ChatGPT on the web.
tunnel.desktopOnly: Configure this connection in the LeafLoom desktop app.
tunnel.keyHelp: Use a runtime key with Tunnels Read + Use. It is encrypted by the system. Leave blank to keep the saved key.
tunnel.keyPlaceholder: Enter your OpenAI Tunnel runtime key
tunnel.auto: Enable and connect when the app starts
tunnel.lifecycle: Closing the window keeps the connection running. Quitting stops it. Disconnecting also disables automatic connection.
tunnel.statusHelp: Channel ready means the local service and Tunnel are prepared. Add the plugin in ChatGPT the first time.
tunnel.unsaved: Connection changes are not saved. Use the save button above.
tunnel.setup: When the channel is ready, add a custom MCP in ChatGPT: choose Tunnel, use the same Tunnel ID, select No authentication, then install and select it in a chat.
tunnel.privacy: ChatGPT receives the knowledge returned by each tool call. Associate the Tunnel only with accounts or workspaces you trust. Stop any manually started client to avoid duplicate runtimes.
tunnel.search: ChatGPT, Tunnel ID, App Key, credentials, connection
tunnel.error.config: Invalid Tunnel ID or configuration. Check the settings and reconnect.
tunnel.error.key: The runtime key is missing or was rejected. Check your App Key.
tunnel.error.permission: Access denied. Check the runtime key’s Tunnels Read + Use permissions and workspace association.
tunnel.error.tunnel: Tunnel not found. Check its ID and organization.
tunnel.error.mcp: Local MCP is unavailable or initialization failed. Retrying automatically.
tunnel.error.binary: The bundled Tunnel runtime is missing. Reinstall LeafLoom with Tunnel support.
tunnel.error.encryption: System encryption is unavailable or decryption failed. Check the system key store and save the key again.
tunnel.error.storage: Unable to read or save connection settings. Check permissions on the app state directory.
tunnel.error.process: The Tunnel runtime is not running correctly. Reconnect or open the logs.
tunnel.error.network: OpenAI Tunnel is temporarily unreachable. Retrying automatically; check your network or proxy.
tunnel.error.link: Unable to open the external page or log folder.
